description: Owners only (needs sign-in): Use when the owner wants to tell their AI agent and AI assistants what to say to customers, for example closed days, policies or what's included. Replace the business's notes for customers: policies and what's included (supplies, pets, access, parking, what isn't done). Assistants answer customers' questions before booking from these notes, and the owner edits them in the Latchbell dashboard. Pass the whole new text (up to 2000 characters): read the current notes in my_business first and keep what still applies. Save only what the owner told you, and show them the new notes before saving.
name: set_customer_notes
title: Save notes for customers
